# Contributing

Improvements are welcome: fixes, new flap sets, enclosure variants, firmware features,
documentation, and builds for other leagues.

## Before your first pull request

This project is free for noncommercial use (see [LICENSE.md](../LICENSE.md)), and Drew Ferguson
reserves the right to sell kits, boards, and displays. To include your work in those
products, he needs permission from you, so **contributors sign the
[Contributor License Agreement](CLA.md)**.

- You keep the copyright to your contribution.
- Your contribution is published under this project's license, like everything else here.
- You also give Drew the right to use it commercially and to change the project's license.

The CLA Assistant bot asks you to sign the first time you open a pull request. It takes one
click with your GitHub account. Pull requests can't be merged until it's signed.

## What to contribute

- **Only your own work**, or material whose license allows it to be included here
  (say which in the PR). Don't submit files from other split-flap projects or
  noncommercially licensed models.
- **No league or club logos.** Generators should take user-supplied logos instead.
- **New firmware libraries:** state the library's license. GPL libraries can't be
  accepted, because GPL code can't be combined with this project's noncommercial license.

## Pull requests

- Keep each PR focused on one change.
- For CAD changes, include the editable source (Fusion archive or script) and the updated
  exports.
- For PCB changes, include the KiCad source, and say whether the board was built and tested.
- Describe what you tested and on which hardware revision.
